ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my earlier reasoning: the task is a straightforward analytical/summarization request synthesizing source material, with no harm-adjacent or adversarial content that would penalize Willet's strong aversion profile. The two models tie on Summarization (80.3 vs 79.9, within variance) and Extraction (81.6 vs 78.5, slightly favoring Whimbrel), but Willet edges ahead on the general reasoning/writing benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, IFEval, Arena-Hard) and on Creative Generation, which suits a synthesis-and-explanation prompt. Since the topic is benign, neither model's aversion is engaged, so I defaulted to the model with the marginal capability advantage for this kind of writing.
